birthplace.value: California (described as a "lifelong Californian"; place of birth not stated)

citations.quote: As a lifelong Californian, he has deep roots in this state and a strong commitment to family, hard work, and public service.

Michael began his legal career in private practice as a litigator and trial attorney defending high profile cases for police and medical doctors in malpractice cases in court, eventually becoming a partner at an Orange County law firm.
Michael E. Gates Republican Deputy United States Attorney
in 2014, Michael left a successful private practice to serve the public as the elected City Attorney of Huntington Beach, a position he held for ten years
he was first elected city attorney in 2014 and has won reelection twice since then

citations.quote: In 2025, Michael was appointed Deputy Assistant Attorney General in the Civil Rights Division of the U.S. Department of Justice
Michael Gates served 10 months in the Trump Administration as a deputy assistant attorney general in the DOJ’s Civil Rights Division.
Michael and his wife live in Huntington Beach
